description.zh: 夏威夷火山国家公园包含两座活跃火山——基拉韦厄和冒纳罗亚，是世界上地质活动最活跃的地区之一。熔岩流入海洋的壮观景象和多样的生态系统吸引着来自全球的游客。
description.en: Hawaii Volcanoes NP contains two of the world's most active volcanoes — Kilauea and Mauna Loa. The sight of lava flowing into the ocean and the park's diverse ecosystems draw visitors from around the globe.
